name: Equipment Rental Operations
audience: independent equipment, tool, and event-rental businesses
topic: return condition and overdue follow-up for rental operations

products.name: Return Damage Evidence
products.product: A focused equipment rental return damage documentation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent equipment, tool, and event-rental businesses
products.problem: Return condition, checkout condition, photos, meter readings, customer acknowledgment, repair cost, and availability decisions often live in separate yard and office workflows.
products.valueProposition: Turns equipment rental return damage documentation into a visible operating queue so every returned asset is inspected against checkout evidence and any damage decision is documented before billing or release.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets rental equipment damage inspection, rental return checklist, equipment damage documentation, and rental asset condition report searches.

products.name: Overdue Rental Follow-Up
products.product: A focused overdue equipment rental follow-up workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent equipment, tool, and event-rental businesses
products.problem: When an asset is not returned, contract status, customer contact, extension approval, future reservation impact, and billing changes are coordinated manually.
products.valueProposition: Turns overdue equipment rental follow-up into a visible operating queue so every overdue contract has confirmed asset status, an authorized return or extension plan, and protected downstream reservations.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets overdue rental equipment, rental return reminder, equipment rental extension, and rental asset recovery workflow searches.
